name: fluentmcp
description: Full control of FluentCRM, FluentCart, WP Social Ninja, Fluent Forms, and FluentCommunity on your WordPress site: contacts, campaigns, orders, products, reviews, forms, spaces, courses, and more.
long_description: Gives your AI assistant create/read/update/delete control over FluentCRM (email marketing & CRM), FluentCart (e-commerce), WP Social Ninja (reviews, social feeds, chat widgets), Fluent Forms (forms & submissions) and FluentCommunity (spaces, feeds, chat, courses) by WPManageNinja — 1,290 documented REST endpoints, each as its own individualized tool (crm_contacts_list, cart_orders_refund, social_reviews_list, forms_submissions_list, community_spaces_list, …), with a built-in tool_map index so the assistant finds the right tool in one call. Safe by default: every destructive tool (deletes, refunds, cancels, mass-sends, resets) is annotated and refuses to run without explicit confirmation. One WordPress Application Password runs everything; run the verify_setup tool after installing to check your connection. Prefer a small tool list? Set the Tool Surface option to "grouped".

site_url.title: WordPress Site URL
site_url.description: Your site's home page address including https://, e.g. https://example.com (not the /wp-admin address).

api_username.title: WordPress Username
api_username.description: Recommended: a separate WordPress user just for Claude (Users → Add New User, role Administrator). If you ever need to cut off access, revoke its Application Password or delete that user — your own login is untouched.

api_password.title: Application Password
api_password.description: In WordPress go to Users → All Users, edit the Claude user, scroll to Application Passwords, type a name such as Claude, click Add New Application Password and paste the password here (spaces are fine). One password runs every product's tools.

tool_mode.title: Tool Surface
tool_mode.description: individual (default): one tool per operation — 1,299 small tools plus a tool_map index. grouped: about 80 tools (one per area, an action parameter picks the operation) for clients that struggle with large tool lists.

tools.name: tool_map
tools.description: This map — overview, per-area drill-down, keyword search.

tools.name: verify_setup
tools.description: Check credentials, connectivity, and plugin presence per product.

tools.name: support_report
tools.description: Redacted diagnostic report (version, connection checks, recent errors) to paste into a support request or GitHub issue.
